name: chatgpt-chrome-bridge
description: Give Codex a context-isolated ChatGPT worker with sanitized repository bundles, durable Pro status, generated-file retrieval, and browser inspection.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel research with safe repository bundles.
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex a parallel, context-isolated ChatGPT worker for self-contained general research, exploration, planning, generic design, drafting, explicit file analysis, deliberately authorized sanitized repository snapshots, generated artifacts, and second opinions. ChatGPT receives only the submitted prompt plus exact user-authorized attachments and cannot see the Codex conversation, project, repository, unlisted files, terminal, local UI, or other agents. It creates local Git-aware repository ZIPs with mandatory runtime/credential exclusions, no symlink traversal, conservative secret-pattern scanning, whole-file omission, hashes, and review manifests without transmitting them automatically. It validates upload limits, converts HEIC/HEIF photos to temporary JPEG copies without changing originals, keeps isolated signed-in Chrome workers ready in the background, globally spaces actual submissions, supports hour-plus Pro processing without treating interim progress cards as final, downloads response files with hashes and MCP resource links, and preserves a signed-in browser inspection fail-safe. It discovers current model and reasoning choices and returns each result for Codex to adapt and verify locally.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a self-contained general research workstream to ChatGPT
Get a second opinion from my ChatGPT account
Analyze exact files I explicitly attach to ChatGPT
Prepare a reviewed sanitized repository ZIP for an authorized ChatGPT attachment
Have ChatGPT generate a file and retrieve it locally
Sync the ChatGPT options available to my account
